name: Kevin's Natural Foods Chicken Tikka Masala (Costco 2-Pack)
whyItWorks: Made with sous-vide cooked, ultra-tender chicken breast and a coconut-milk-based curry sauce instead of heavy cream or butter. Certified gluten-free and dairy-free with clean ingredients that avoid inflammatory dairy fats.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sear chicken in a skillet for 1-2 minutes, drain juices, and simmer in the coconut tikka sauce. Serve over a bowl of plain steamed white basmati or jasmine rice.
